entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2603a
entries.finding: COSMOS Field MoM-z14 Galaxy (NIRCam pullout image): Webb NIRCam, ten filters from 0.9 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 1024 × 1024 px over 0.58 arcsec. The publisher's file carries no sky tags. Nine saturated stars of the field were matched to Gaia DR3 (least squares, rms 0.47 arcsec): 0.2453 arcsec per pixel at the 4,000 px Publication JPEG, 0.0399 arcsec per pixel at full size, north 90.1° left of vertical; the paper's position falls 0.4 arcsec from the centre of the small square the publisher draws on the field. That square is 22 px inside (0.879 arcsec) and the enlarged view 4,537 px inside, so one pixel of the enlarged view is 0.000194 arcsec, to about 5% (one pixel of the square). The window is 3,000 px of the enlarged view centred on the galaxy's light, clear of the publisher's label.
